review:
Poison Eve is a 5x3 botanical slot with expanding vine wilds that always cover their reel. When Poison Eve lands fully on reel 1, Liquid Magic turns every bottle symbol into her.

A bonus symbol in the hot zone on reel 5 triggers Flower Power, which opens a portal on the leftmost reel. Nolimit rates it Medium volatility, with a 6,091x cap. Elegant and gentle by Nolimit standards.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
